purpose: Expose the canonical append-only Song Activity chronology through the normal /song surface as an artist-readable newest-first 'What changed?' timeline, resolving known Song/Version/material/session/learning/focus events into human language, preserving canonical order without inventing timestamps, and degrading unknown future event types without leaking internal IDs or payloads.

lineage.outcome: The artist can answer what changed in this Song without reconstructing history from separate Version, Session and memory panels.
lineage.capability: Consumer-readable canonical Song Activity timeline / What changed?

why_now: REQ-SCOPE-104 requires a universal chronological Artist activity timeline. CORE-01 Activity is already canonical and downstream Session/Learning/Focus layers already project Song-bound events into it. Recent SONG-01 work also adds meaningful Version/current/approval chronology. The missing seam is consumer reachability, not another event store.
instead_of: Another Version control is not selected because visible/history/audition/current/approval now cover the basic owned-Version loop and additional adjacency has diminishing leverage.
Full loudness-aware A/B remains unselected because the clean-room destination lacks a truthful loudness-analysis/normalization substrate.
First-class reference objects remain important but require a new persistent evidence model; Activity can expose already-owned cross-domain truth immediately.
Musical derivation remains unselected because no clean-room audio-analysis engine exists.
Another DAW chassis increment is not selected because Song operating-memory reachability is host-independent and already construction-ready.

legacy_rejections: claiming universal cross-provider population before those domains exist

completion_proof: the normal /song surface shows a bounded newest-first What changed? timeline for the exact active Song using canonical Activity sequence ordering
known Song, material, Version, current, approval, Session, Learning, Evidence and Song-bound Focus event types render artist-readable labels without raw event/object/profile IDs
Version and Asset events resolve canonical labels/names from current immutable lineage rather than trusting event object IDs as presentation text
Session/Learning/Focus payloads expose only bounded artist-language fields and do not dump raw JSON
unknown future Song event types remain visibly represented by a safe generic history item instead of being silently discarded or exposing internal event_type text
no wall-clock date/time is displayed because Activity currently owns sequence order but no canonical timestamp
timeline reads are pure and do not mutate Song, Version, approval, Session, Learning, Evidence, Focus, Operations, DAWs or providers
multiple Songs/profiles remain isolated and Quit/relaunch preserves the same chronology
authored read-model/HTTP/restart proof remains separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
next_selection_rule: After this increment lands or blocks, globally reselect from the whole graph. Compare references, fuller Compare/A-B, Learning/Skill consumer reachability, Creative Studio, audio-analysis substrate, DAW/OPS and other portfolio outcomes.
